headline: AI boom! Taiwan's exports this year will overtake Japan and South Korea and surpass Hong Kong, likely becoming the world's fifth-largest exporter
summary: The Ministry of Finance estimates Taiwan's full-year 2026 exports could exceed US$900 billion, with AI demand driving growth that could make it the world's fifth-largest exporter.
why: Taiwan is a major supplier of advanced chips and electronics, so its export trends signal global demand for AI hardware.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: AI大爆發！台灣今年出口將追過日韓、超香港 有望晉升全球第五大出口國
